The measurements change depending on taste. I taste test it throughout the process and once it gets to the correct taste I place the meat into it.

I usually marinade it for around 4 to 6 hours. I take it out of the marinade about 30 to 45 minutes before grilling. I take paper towels and dry them off. I let the meat come to room temp while I heat the grill to as hot as I can get it. I then sear both sides for 2 to 3 minutes each depending on thickness of steak. Searing Process: 1.5 minutes on the side I turn 90 degrees and let it grill for another 1.5 minutes to a total of 3 minutes a side. After each side is sealed in I then move them to the broiling rack for about 2 to 3 minutes per each side. After that I take off the grill and place in foil until 5 to 6 minute has passed. I then serve. Now cooking times may vary due to thickness of the cut and the cut itself. That is my baseline. The meat is usually pink in the center and there are nice grill marks in a diamond pattern.
